resale_co.name: Certificate of Compliance, Sale/Title Transfer
resale_co.lead_time: Apply at least 10 business days before closing for the lowest fee
requirements: Smoke detectors on each level and outside each sleeping area (10 year sealed or hardwired)
Carbon monoxide detector near all sleeping areas (less than 10 years old)
ABC fire extinguisher mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen, no larger than 10 pounds (as printed on the form)
GFCI outlets where required, working properly
Metal dryer vent connector, not plastic
No garbage disposal (not allowed by Borough ordinance)
Sump pump discharge meets Borough ordinance
Sidewalks and curbs in good condition
Permits obtained for all work (plumbing, electric, furnace, water heater, etc.); open permits may delay the certificate
Furnace or boiler certification or checklist by a licensed HVAC or plumbing contractor
Level 2 chimney certification by a nationally certified chimney sweep for a wood-burning fireplace

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for Certificate of Compliance, Sale/Title Transfer (closing date, owner, agent, buyer names) and submit it with the fee and the required furnace or boiler certification (and Level 2 chimney certification if there is a wood-burning fireplace) to the Code Enforcement Office, 156 Bank Street, Hightstown. Cash or check only, payable to Borough of Hightstown. The Borough then calls to schedule the inspection; a lockbox code may be given for a vacant home. The form can also be emailed to DBell@HightstownBorough.com.

resale_co.notes: The Borough posts a current (2026) Application for Certificate of Compliance for a sale or title transfer with closing-date fee tiers, filed with the Code Enforcement Office and signed off by the Housing Inspector. The Borough code (ecode360 HI1169) could not be opened, so the ordinance wording and how long the certificate is valid were not seen. The file name says Rev 3.26 but the footer still says Revised: 01/2025. The Borough website blocks plain automated requests (HTTP 406); the web pages were read through a normal page fetch, and the PDF form loads directly. A separate Change of Tenant Inspection Request Form and annual rental registration apply to rentals, not sales. The Construction & Zoning page (read through a normal page fetch because plain requests get HTTP 406) lists Dave Bell, Housing Inspector, 609-490-5100 Ext. 407, with an email link to dbell@hightstownborough.com, and Chad Reed, Fire Official, 609-490-5100 Ext. 602, with an email link to fireprevention@hightstownborough.com.

fire_cert.notes: The state registry lists Hightstown Borough (municipality) as the fire code enforcing agency. The state directory (2022 survey) names the Borough Construction Office as the smoke detector compliance office, and the Borough's sale Certificate of Compliance checklist includes the smoke, CO and extinguisher items. The Fire Official is Chad Reed (609-490-5100 Ext. 602, fireprevention@hightstownborough.com, per the Borough Construction & Zoning and Fire Prevention pages); the Fire Prevention page has general smoke alarm advice but no resale certificate information. No separate smoke certificate fee was found.

other_items.label: Furnace or boiler certification
other_items.detail: Furnace/Boiler certification or checklist completed by a licensed HVAC or plumbing contractor must be submitted with the application.

other_items.label: Chimney certification
other_items.detail: Level 2 wood-burning fireplace chimney certification by a nationally certified chimney sweep, if there is a wood-burning fireplace.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: Open permits may delay the Certificate of Compliance; permits must have been obtained for all work.
